---
title: "Map Family"
---

## map

```{r}
v <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
v
```

```{r}
# input: vector (atomic vector)
# output: list
v |> purrr::map(\(x) x * 2)
```

```{r}
# input: vector (atomic vector)
# output: double (atomic) vector
v |> purrr::map_dbl(\(x) x * 2)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(a=c(1,1,1), 
                 b=c(2,2,2), 
                 c=c(3,3,3), 
                 d=c(4,4,4))
df
```

```{r}
# input: vector (dataframe)
# output: list
df |> purrr::map(\(x) x * 2)
```

```{r}
# input: vector (dataframe)
# output: dataframe
df |> purrr::map_df(\(x) x * 2)
```


## map2

```{r}
v1 <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
v2 <- c(5, 6, 7, 8)

v1 |> purrr::map2(v2, \(x, y) x * y)
```


## pmap

```{r}
v <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
list(v) |> purrr::pmap(\(x) x * 2)
```

```{r}
v <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
list(v, v) |> purrr::pmap(\(x, y) x * y)
```

```{r}
v <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
list(v, v, v) |> purrr::pmap(\(x, y, z) x * y * z)
```
